testcase.system-out: Scenario: Fit a distant block using Zoom All ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its rectangular solid active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the block appears small within the viewport ✔ When the user opens the Zoom menu on the navigation bar ✔ Then the menu offers Zoom, Zoom All, Zoom Window and Zoom Selected ✔ When the user chooses Zoom All ✔ Then the block appears larger and its visible outline fits within the viewport ✔ And the same part and orientation remain active ✔ When the user reopens the Zoom menu ✔ Then Zoom All is marked as the selected action ✔ When the user selects Zoom and presses Escape ✔ Then the status area displays Ready
